$comment: Authored native status for the v1.2.0 event catalog, applied by tools/SurfaceInventory/build-event-catalog.mjs --overlay over the v1.1.0 catalog (which already carries the v1.1.0 overlay). Only before_agent_start changed natively: its event is a union on messageType (user or custom) and it also fires for runs started by a custom message with triggerTurn. Assessed against PiSharp sources at f1d4b32d1e10a804b0b34e3c8522caa87d3f3f07. Tests are authored and registered, not executed by the refresh.

nativeEvidence.registration: IExtensionRegistry.RegisterBeforeAgentStartHandler (ExtensionBeforeAgentStartEvent.MessageType User or Custom; Message carries the starting custom message of a Custom run)
nativeEvidence.hostEmission: ExtensionAgentBinding.ContextHooks.BeforePrompt for prompt runs and for runs started by a custom message with triggerTurn (PersistentAgentSession.SendCustomMessageAsync), wrapped by PersistentAgentSession.PrepareRunStartAsync (busy start, held messages, abort at start)

gaps: bridge.events-reach-node-handlers loads a Node extension, which registers through PiNodeOwner in the same ExtensionRegistry; it needs Node.js and reports SKIP_NO_NODE without it.

Node extensions receive messageType and message once the Node bridge passes them (PiNodeOwner before_agent_start slot and runtime.mjs); until then a TypeScript handler sees a custom run as a user event with an empty prompt.
